}}{{TIDTOC|embedded}} ==Overview== "7016A0608004 Ver:1.00" is silkscreened on the board in the FCC photos. :The device uses two ''Lynwave'' ALA120-052022 antennas.
The PoE implementation in this device consists of a Passive PoE feed with pins +4,5 and -7,8 at 18 VDC.
